header.description: Replay a fitted attention-head DBM mask (dbm_head.json) on a held-out split without re-fitting: the gate's file_path loads the fitted per-head theta, the stage comes back in eval mode, and the swap runs through the same hard theta>0 mask over heads the fit was scored on. The gate declares group: head as the fit did - the bundle's stamped group and group_map (heads, head_dim) are checked against what this document's site derives, so a mask fitted over 16 query heads of 256 is refused at a DeltaNet layer's 32 value heads of 128, or through a per-coordinate gate, by name [V15]. No train section: the number saved is a confirmation one by construction. No entry selector: dbm_head.json fits one cell, so the bundle holds a single theta. The dtype is part of the fit's ArtifactIdentity; omit it and the document implies fp32 and is refused against a bf16 fit.
